invoice_lines_rabatt.name: invoice_lines_rabatt
invoice_lines_rabatt.value: ("ddl"."invoice_lines"."rabatt_art" is null and "ddl"."invoice_lines"."rabatt_wert" is null and "ddl"."invoice_lines"."rabatt_cent" = 0) or ("ddl"."invoice_lines"."rabatt_art" in ('prozent', 'betrag') and "ddl"."invoice_lines"."rabatt_wert" > 0)

order_positions_rabatt.name: order_positions_rabatt
order_positions_rabatt.value: ("ddl"."order_positions"."rabatt_art" is null and "ddl"."order_positions"."rabatt_wert" is null) or ("ddl"."order_positions"."rabatt_art" = 'betrag' and "ddl"."order_positions"."rabatt_wert" > 0) or ("ddl"."order_positions"."rabatt_art" = 'prozent' and "ddl"."order_positions"."rabatt_wert" between 1 and 10000)
